Ava (People Ops): @channel Quick heads up — today we published an update to our leave policies that adds a formal sabbatical program and clarifies unpaid leave rules. Details below and an FAQ + office hours link at the end. :sparkles:

Marco (People Ops): TL;DR: eligible after 4 years full-time (pro-rated for part-time), up to 6 weeks paid sabbatical + option for additional unpaid sabbatical up to 12 weeks. Global heads see country-specific notes.

Sam (Eng): Why 4 years? curious if we can make a case earlier for ICs who have been with us long in contractor roles.

Ava (People Ops): Good Q — eligibility counts Redwood continuous service (FT or converted contractor start date). Exceptions can be requested via manager + People Ops review; we expect those to be rare.

Priya (Product): How does paid sabbatical affect benefits/tenure? does it pause accruals?

Marco (People Ops): Paid sabbatical keeps benefits as-is for the paid period. Vacation/PTO accruals continue at the usual rate for paid sabbatical weeks. For unpaid sabbatical, benefits continuation depends on region — see the country notes. Tenure continues (no break in service).

Jin (Eng-ML): Process question — what's the workflow? approvals, payroll, and how to book in calendar?

Ava (People Ops): Process in 3 steps: 1) Discuss with your manager and confirm dates, 2) Submit a sabbatical request form in Workday (link below) at least 8 weeks before start, 3) People Ops will confirm payroll/benefits status and publish an official LOA record. Workday Bot will post the LOA to your profile once approved.

Workday Bot: Your sabbatical request form: http://go.redwood/workday-sabbatical | Use code SAB2026 when prompted.

Sam (Eng): Is there any limit on how often you can take a sabbatical? like once every X years?

Marco (People Ops): You can take sabbatical every 4 years of service. We encourage planning around product cycles and manager coordination so team coverage is smooth.

Priya (Product): For international folks — any visa/immigration guidance?

Ava (People Ops): Short answer: check with People Ops + Legal before booking. Longer: unpaid sabbatical may affect visa status for some countries — our Legal team flagged the UK, Germany, and India as requiring pre-approval. We added a visa checklist in the FAQ.

Jin (Eng-ML): Do sabbaticals count toward eligibility for parental leave or other long-service benefits?

Marco (People Ops): Yes, sabbatical weeks count as continuous service for other long-service benefit eligibility (e.g., parental leave thresholds).

Priya (Product): What about partial-week requests? like 2 weeks on, 1 week off for caregiving?

Ava (People Ops): We prefer contiguous sabbaticals for clarity, but shorter or split arrangements can be approved in exceptional cases — include rationale in the Workday request.

Sam (Eng): One more — manager approval required? or just FYI?

Ava (People Ops): Manager approval is required. People Ops reviews for policy compliance and payroll. Company exec sign-off only needed for >12 weeks unpaid or non-standard exceptions.

Priya (Product): Thanks! can we get a calendar widget for team planning? would help with hiring cycles.
notes: Office hours link and FAQ posted in the docs site — office hours tomorrow 10am PT.
